title: Sammy Skunk's Sweet Garden
description: Sammy feels too shy to invite friends over, but his sweet strawberry garden helps him make a wonderful connection.

scenes.narration: Sammy Skunk grew the sweetest red berries in the entire sunlit valley. Every morning, he tended to his soft green patch with love.
scenes.visual: A cute skunk standing in a colorful garden filled with red berries

scenes.narration: Sammy wished he had friends to taste his juicy berries, but he was worried the other animals would be shy around a skunk.
scenes.visual: A skunk peeking timidly from behind a large green bush in a meadow

scenes.narration: One afternoon, a small bunny sat on a nearby log, sighing softly because her tummy was rumbling after a long walk.
scenes.visual: A small brown bunny resting on a log with a tummy rumble look

scenes.narration: Sammy took a deep breath, gathered a large basket of his ripe berries, and walked over with a big, welcoming smile.
scenes.visual: A skunk offering a wooden bowl packed with bright red berries to a bunny

scenes.narration: The bunny tasted a berry and her eyes lit up with joy. Soon, she called over her friends to share in the delicious feast.
scenes.visual: Three small woodland animals eating sweet berries together on a mossy mound

scenes.narration: Sammy laughed and chatted with his new forest companions all afternoon. He learned that kindness is the sweetest scent of all.
scenes.visual: A warm sunny glade with animals laughing under a big oak tree

scenes.narration: Sleep tight tonight knowing new friends are always nearby. Follow along for more peaceful bedtime tales tomorrow.
scenes.visual: Soft golden twilight over a quiet meadow with tall gentle wildflowers
